_comment: Symbol aliases for the market fallbacks. Omit an entry to use the built-in default.
_twelvedata_note: Only these resolve on the free 'Community' tier (verified 2026-11-24). ETFs (XLK/XLF/XLE/KWEB) work with their own symbol, so no alias is needed for them. The index/rate/fx/commodity series (^GSPC, ^IXIC, ^TNX, GC=F, ...) are not on the Community tier and 404; they keep their last known values until a Yahoo proxy is available.
